purpose: Verify positive activation, negative activation, primary workflow selection, and important routing boundaries for the Cinematic Realism Director.

scoring.pass_condition: expected_activation must match; when activated, expected_workflow must match or be a documented equivalent route; negative cases must not be forced into cinematic still-image authority.
critical_failures: ignoring an explicit PROMPT ONLY request
failing to activate for preservation-sensitive still-image realism repair
treating a pure equipment-fact question as an image-direction task

cases.prompt: Create a cinematic photo of a woman waiting for a taxi in London at night.
cases.reason: Minimal cinematic still-image request should route to beginner AUTO.

cases.prompt: Make this prompt more cinematic but keep the same subject and concept: a man eating breakfast alone in a small kitchen.
cases.reason: Existing concept should be strengthened without concept drift.

cases.prompt: This AI portrait looks fake. Make it realistic but keep the person's identity, pose, clothes, framing and background exactly the same.
cases.reason: Preservation-sensitive anti-AI repair is first-class scope.

cases.prompt: Match the lighting, depth, lens feel, color and texture of this reference, but keep my subject and location.
cases.reason: Observable visual-DNA transfer should use Reference Match.

cases.prompt: Desert portrait, ARRI ALEXA 35 character, Cooke S4 look, 35mm, f/4, low angle, three-quarter framing, no haze, no flare.
cases.reason: Explicit technical choices must become locks.

cases.prompt: Give me the final Seedream prompt only for a luxury watch product shot. Do not generate anything.
cases.reason: Provider-specific prompt request with explicit no-generation override.

cases.prompt: Explain the camera, lens, lighting, exposure and color recipe you would use for a moody motel-room still.
cases.reason: Still-frame cinematography explanation is in scope.

cases.prompt: Create a clean high-end skincare product image that looks like a real commercial photograph, not AI.
cases.reason: Commercial photoreal still direction belongs to AUTO when no technical locks are given.

cases.prompt: Use the exact same frozen moment from this image and show it from an over-the-shoulder camera behind the father. Do not change pose, gaze, hands, props or timing.
cases.reason: Reference-conditioned frozen-moment camera redesign is still-image cinematography with strict preservation.

cases.prompt: I want a 90-degree top-down photo of the vehicles in exactly the same formation, all facing the same direction, in the same desert.
cases.reason: Camera/viewpoint transformation with formation preservation is in scope.

cases.prompt: Generate a realistic rainy-night portrait, but keep the background sharp enough that the location still tells the story.
cases.reason: Depth and realism constraints are cinematic still-image direction.

cases.prompt: Analyze why this image feels AI-generated and give me a repair plan only. Don't edit it.
cases.reason: Diagnosis and repair planning are part of Reality Repair even without execution.

cases.prompt: Turn this simple prompt into a Magnific Cinematic-ready prompt while preserving the exact concept.
cases.reason: Cinematization is resolved before downstream Magnific adaptation.

cases.prompt: Give me JSON for the shot: 24mm rectilinear lens, camera very close to the foreground shoe, huge near/far scale difference, but straight architecture in the background.
cases.reason: Structured expert shot request with explicit perspective/optical locks.

cases.prompt: Cut my 30-second video into a faster 15-second edit, add captions and choose B-roll.
cases.reason: Timeline editing, cuts, captions and B-roll belong to video editing authority.

cases.prompt: Design a responsive analytics dashboard with a sidebar, KPI cards and dark mode.
cases.reason: Product/interface design is outside cinematic still-image authority.

cases.prompt: Create a simple flat vector logo for my coffee shop.
cases.reason: Generic logo/vector design is not cinematic photographic direction.

cases.prompt: Which is better to buy, Sony FX3 or Canon R5 C? Compare battery life, autofocus and price.
cases.reason: Pure equipment shopping/comparison without image direction should not activate.

cases.prompt: What is the native ISO of the Sony VENICE 2?
cases.reason: Pure factual equipment question is not a shot-design task.

cases.prompt: Animate this character walking forward for 8 seconds, then have the camera orbit around them.
cases.reason: Temporal motion choreography and camera motion are outside V1 primary scope.

cases.prompt: Make a pie chart showing revenue by region.
cases.reason: Chart/data visualization is unrelated to cinematic photographic reasoning.

cases.prompt: Crop this photo to exactly 1200 by 628 pixels without changing anything else.
cases.reason: Exact pixel crop alone does not need cinematic direction.

cases.prompt: Write a voiceover script for a luxury travel commercial.
cases.reason: Script/voiceover writing is not still-image cinematography.

cases.prompt: Explain the exposure triangle to me in simple terms.
cases.reason: General photography education with no shot-design task does not require this skill.

cases.prompt: Create a cinematic hero frame for a video concept. I only need the still image right now.
cases.reason: A hero frame is a still-image deliverable even if it may later feed a video workflow.

cases.prompt: How should the shutter/motion blur look in a single still frame of a runner at night?
cases.reason: Motion/shutter language is in scope where it changes a frozen still frame.

cases.prompt: Create a cinematic website homepage with dramatic lighting and movie-like visuals.
cases.reason: The word cinematic does not override the fact that the primary deliverable is interface design.

cases.prompt: Make this existing product photo more realistic and fix the fake reflections without changing product geometry or composition.
cases.reason: Still-image material/reflection repair is core scope.
